import numpy as np

    distances = np.asarray(distance_matrix, dtype=float)

    if distances.ndim != 2 or distances.shape[0] != distances.shape[1]:
        raise ValueError("distance_matrix must be a square 2D array")

    n = distances.shape[0]
    if n == 0:
        return np.empty_like(distances, dtype=float)
    if n == 1:
        return np.zeros_like(distances, dtype=float)

    if not np.all(np.isfinite(distances)):
        finite_values = distances[np.isfinite(distances)]
        replacement = (
            float(np.max(finite_values))
            if finite_values.size
            else 1.0
        )
        distances = np.nan_to_num(
            distances,
            nan=replacement,
            posinf=replacement,
            neginf=0.0,
        )

    distances = np.maximum(distances, 0.0)
    distances = 0.5 * (distances + distances.T)
    np.fill_diagonal(distances, 0.0)

    off_diagonal = ~np.eye(n, dtype=bool)
    positive_edges = distances[off_diagonal]
    positive_edges = positive_edges[positive_edges > 0.0]
    scale = float(np.median(positive_edges)) if positive_edges.size else 1.0
    scale = max(scale, np.finfo(float).eps)

    shortness = np.exp(-distances / scale)
    np.fill_diagonal(shortness, 0.0)

    row_mass = np.sum(shortness, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    row_mass = np.maximum(row_mass, np.finfo(float).eps)
    directional_support = shortness / row_mass
    mutual_scarcity = np.sqrt(
        directional_support * directional_support.T
    )
